summary: Tested the white-screen resilience work end to end. Backend: 7/7 pytest pass (health, composite 768x1024, slot PNG 1024x1024, health stays fast during 10 parallel composites (max 0.90s, others 0.12-0.5s), 14MB JPEG avatar compressed to 235KB at 1024x768 via to_thread + S3 upload, editor-files S3 upload + raw readback, 401 for bad token). Frontend (Playwright, admin): normal boot OK; /auth/me hang -> loading screen 0.9s, help ('taking longer than usual' + retry) at 10.7s, 'Clara is temporarily unreachable' at 50.2s, token kept, Try again -> dashboard without logout; /auth/me 502 -> unreachable at 5.6s, token kept, 15s auto-retry recovered at 20.5s; 401 -> redirected to /login and token cleared; subdomain-config + routes/public hang -> app booted at 9.9s (8s AbortSignal timeout); forced render crash in ClaraNavigationListener -> app-error-screen with reload + home buttons, home btn recovers; ChunkLoadError -> exactly one automatic reload, sessionStorage clara_chunk_reload=1, no reload loop on second chunk error. Watchdog: 1 'Event loop blocked' line, a FALSE POSITIVE during uvicorn hot-reload shutdown (stack ends in selectors.poll inside shutdown_default_executor).

minor.issue: False positive 'Event loop blocked for 2.5s' logged during app shutdown/hot reload (heartbeat task is cancelled while the watchdog thread keeps running; stack: asyncio/runners.py close -> shutdown_default_executor -> selectors.poll). Stop the watchdog on shutdown (threading.Event set in shutdown handler) or skip reporting when _beat_task.done() / loop is closed.

Still a sync blocker on the event loop: subprocess.run(ffmpeg, timeout=10) + numpy fingerprinting inside an async function used by the audio-trigger scheduler. Wrap in asyncio.to_thread (or asyncio.create_subprocess_exec). Similarly routers/vdc_deploy.py _tunnel_alive() uses subprocess.run(pgrep, timeout=5) from async handlers (fast, low risk).
'RuntimeError: No response returned.' logged when the client disconnects mid-request (BaseHTTPMiddleware). Harmless, but noisy; consider catching it or using a pure ASGI middleware.

action_items: Make loop_watchdog stop/ignore on shutdown so hot reloads/restarts don't log false 'Event loop blocked' errors
Move audio_trigger ffmpeg subprocess.run + numpy analysis off the event loop (to_thread)
Optional: clear sessionStorage 'clara_chunk_reload' after a successful boot so a later deploy in the same tab can auto-reload again
critical_code_review_comments: AppErrorBoundary: 'clara_chunk_reload' flag is never cleared, so in a long-lived tab only the first deploy ever gets the automatic reload; later ChunkLoadErrors show the error screen (still not white, acceptable).

AppLoadingScreen unreachable mode calls onRetry every 15s, while a single fetchUser can take up to ~49s (3 x 15s timeout + backoff) during a hang -> overlapping concurrent /auth/me retries pile up. Guard with an in-flight ref in retryConnection.

fetchUser: JSON.parse(localStorage 'impersonating') is inside the try; a corrupt value sets connectionError even though user is set (harmless because the screen only shows when !user), but better to try/catch and remove the corrupt key.
Error boundary is outside BrowserRouter/AuthProvider - good (covers provider crashes). Note: the fallback itself has no nested boundary; fine as it is static markup.
seed_data_creation: Uploaded a TEST_big.jpg avatar to the admin user (avatar field unset again in Mongo afterwards) and two TEST_editor.png files to S3 editor/.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Writing files under /app/backend/tests triggers a backend hot reload (WatchFiles), which also produces the watchdog false positive. To force an error-boundary crash in dev: patch Array.prototype.map to throw only when new Error().stack matches /ClaraNavigationListener/, then pushState+popstate; remove #webpack-dev-server-client-overlay before asserting. A global map patch crashes the fallback too (test artifact -> blank page). Unreachable mode takes ~50s under a full hang of /auth/me.
